title: [GMCP 203.008.05] Interoperability and quality: Complete schemas, primitives, content, and metadata model
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-008-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Every MCP primitive and content variant is represented losslessly, including annotations, icons, resource links and embedded resources, binary media, extensions, cache scope/TTL, audience and priority metadata, and JSON Schema 2020-12 input/output contracts. Round-trip fixtures preserve unknown extension fields; schema limits, external-reference policy, Unicode, URI and MIME validation, and canonical serialization are exhaustively tested. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
